title: RADIAL REVEAL — every cell sees every other cell. Distance = progressive disclosure. The globe IS the radial.
summary: Every visitor is a CELL on the globe. My white dot IS me (Kevin at desk). All other visitors appear as colored dots at their approximate position. Distance determines how much you see: China sees 'Michigan', same city sees the neighborhood, same LAN sees the desk. Every new point = null body that gets filled by proximity. Triangles: distance, direction, disposition. The globe spinning IS the radial coordinate system — up/down, left/right, inside/outside.

progressive_reveal.principle: Distance determines disclosure. The closer you are, the more the membrane opens.

levels.sees: EVERYTHING — the desk, the code, the organs, the full membrane
The house, the LAN, the devices, the heartbeat
The city, the weather, the neighborhood signals
The state, the timezone, coarse position
The country, the continent, the general direction
Just the globe. A dot. The null body.

every_cell.what_it_is: Every browser tab visiting hud.primals.eco IS a cell in the organism. Each cell gets a seed (unique identity) and a position on the globe.
every_cell.white_dot: Kevin's dot = white = localhost = the ME = the origin point
every_cell.other_dots: Every visitor = a colored dot = a null body that gets revealed by proximity

dot_properties.seed: Unique hash — identifies the cell without revealing identity
dot_properties.rtt_to_server: Latency = approximate distance to Cloudflare edge
dot_properties.user_agent_class: Desktop/Mobile/Bot — what KIND of body this cell has

the_three_Ds.distance: How far is this cell? (RTT + timezone + IP geolocation hint)
the_three_Ds.disposition: What is this cell doing? (which pages visited, how long stayed, scroll depth)

triangulation.backscatter: If I'm talking to someone in China and a nearby visitor appears, the nearby visitor helps TRIANGULATE my position. I don't need to know WHERE anyone is — I use the RELATIONSHIP between cells to locate them relative to each other.
triangulation.null_body_expansion: Every new cell starts as a null body — no identity, no position, just a dot. As it interacts, proximity data fills in: timezone narrows longitude, RTT narrows distance, page visits reveal disposition. The null body gradually becomes a REAL body.

the_globe_as_radial.what_kevin_saw: The globe's rotation IS the radial coordinate system. The spinning gives left/right (longitude). The latitude gives up/down. The inside/outside gives internal/external (CIS/TRANS).
the_globe_as_radial.mesh_grid: The flat mesh topology (from earlier work) = the FACE between positive and negative space. It's the planar cut through the globe.
the_globe_as_radial.radial: The globe's depth and rotation = the cylindrical/spherical coordinate system. Every cell has (r, θ, φ) = (distance from center, longitude, latitude).
the_globe_as_radial.anderson: Kevin asked: is the globe the QS Anderson? The globe's spinning and cycling IS the Anderson gate — the quality system that routes signals between inside and outside. The rotation IS the switching. The cycle IS the processing.
